attempts.summary: Deployed a rootless Podman container (nginx:alpine) as unprivileged user appsvc on node1, published on port 8080, managed by a Podman Quadlet systemd --user unit (webapp.service) wired into default.target. Enabled loginctl linger for appsvc so the user's systemd instance and container start at boot without any active login session. Verified with a full node reboot: boot ID changed, no login sessions existed post-boot, yet the container auto-started and served HTTP 200 on port 8080.
